description: Append one or more questions (with their answers and optional images) to an existing quiz.

questions.description: One or more questions to append to the quiz.

answers.description: Answer options for this question; exactly one should be marked isCorrect=true.

additionalInfo.description: Optional explanation or trivia shown after the answer is revealed.

isCorrect.description: Whether this answer is the correct one for the question.

order.description: 1-indexed display order of the answer within the question.

ttsText.description: Optional exact narration line for the answer reveal.

duration.description: Seconds viewers have to answer this question (must be >= 1).

imagePath.description: Optional primary image URL shown with the question (used by picture_guess quizzes).

images.description: Additional images attached to the question (in addition to imagePath).

alt.description: Alt text describing the image for accessibility.

sourceUrl.description: Original attribution URL for the image, if any.

url.description: Absolute URL of the image asset.

order.description: 1-indexed display order of the question within the quiz.

questionText.description: The question prompt shown to viewers.

ttsText.description: Optional exact narration line for this question.

quizId.description: Quiz ID in YouTube-style 11-character base64url format.

name: quiz_video_add_quiz_questions
title: Add questions to a quiz
